_note: What a card's own texture looks like, measured from the extracted art. 'saturated' is the share of opaque pixels with any real colour; the rest is monochrome line work. The rule of thumb is by card type, not by the 纯色材质 tag: that tag separated the two on four samples and failed on 44.
referenceRule: reference/cards/<type>-<rare>.png, one extracted vanilla card per combination. When present, art.mjs switches to image-to-image so the mode and palette follow a real card instead of a description.
cardFace: 472x1028 RGBA. The texture is the inner picture ONLY and it is transparent: an extracted vanilla card is about 53% alpha=0. The game draws the frame, the corner ornaments, the help button and the plate underneath.
headIcon: A texture with the same name at 92x92 exists for some cards; extract-art writes it under head/.

plate._note: The base plate (底牌) is not part of the card texture. It is a Unity Material per rarity, named stone/copper/silver/gold, applied through game.json card_materials. Read out of resources.assets. Colours are the material's _Color.
plate.consequence: Never paint a background into the card texture. An opaque picture covers the plate and shows as a rectangle on the card. Generate on full transparency and let the material show through.
